name: Arnold Allen

official.source: data/derived/fighters.json (68 in height, 70 in reach, southpaw, featherweight). Recent fights: lost to Jean Silva by unanimous decision at UFC 324 (2026-01-24, Cageside Press); beat Melquizael Costa by unanimous decision over five rounds at UFC Vegas 117 (2026-05-16, ESPN).

photo_coverage: Good. Front: ESPN studio headshot, Jan 2026 press conference, May 2026 weigh-in, and the only Commons photo (2019 interview still, CC BY 3.0, magenta cast). Profile: May 2026 face-off (right side). Physique: two ESPN cutouts, Jan and May 2026 weigh-ins. No fight-action photo was downloadable (UFC.com refused the image request). Hair has changed a lot over the years, so follow the 2026 photos.

face.shape: Long and narrow, oval to rectangular, with a long lower third (nose to chin). Lean with flat cheeks.
face.jaw: Narrow, lightly angled; the short beard adds some width.
face.chin: Long and fairly prominent, slightly squared at the bottom.
face.cheekbones: Not especially high; flat planes, slight hollows at fight weight.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit low over the eyes.
face.forehead: Mostly hidden by the fringe in 2025-2026; medium height in the 2019 photo.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium, slightly deep-set under low brows; outer corners level.
eyes.colour: blue (light blue-grey; large pupils in the studio shot make them look dark)

eyebrows.shape: Low and straight, slightly thicker at the inner ends.
eyebrows.colour: Light ginger-blond, paler than the hair.

nose.tip: Slightly rounded and a little fleshy; level to faintly upturned in the May 2026 profile.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-width mouth with a thin upper lip and thin-to-medium lower lip; closed, flat resting line. Broad toothy smile in casual photos.

ears.protrusion: Stick out strongly from the head, the most noticeable feature from the front.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes on his left ear: the upper half is swollen and lumpy with the inner folds filled in (ESPN headshot and both cutouts). His right ear protrudes but has a normal shape, with only slight thickening at the top.

face.notable_marks_scars: No prominent facial scar. Fair skin flushes pink on the cheeks, nose and chest.

hair.style: 2025-2026: a grown-out crop with a heavy straight-cut fringe (bowl-like) falling to mid-forehead, about 6 cm on top, the sides shorter but covering the temples and the tops of the ears, back tapered. By May 2026 the fringe was messier and swept slightly to one side. Older cutouts and 2019: a short textured crop swept to the side.
hair.colour: Medium ash-brown to dark blond in 2026; lighter and redder blond in 2019 and in older cutouts.
hair.hairline: Hidden by the fringe in 2026; straight and full in 2019, no recession.
hair.texture: Straight, fine to medium, a little thick and choppy on top.

facial_hair.colour: Ginger to strawberry-blond, clearly redder and lighter than the hair; the moustache is a little darker copper.
facial_hair.density: Medium; fullest on the moustache and chin, lighter and patchier on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Full moustache joined to a short chin beard and jawline beard; in May 2026 slightly longer (about 8-10 mm) with the moustache hanging over the lip line.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on lit skin (box in source pixels). Highlight or clipped boxes and the magenta 2019 still are left out of the used average. Arena photos read paler and pinker than the studio cutouts.
skin.undertone: Cool-to-neutral pink; flushes red on the cheeks, ears, nose and chest.
skin.freckles_marks: A few small moles on the torso; light reddish body hair on the forearms and legs.

body.build: Lean, wiry featherweight at 173 cm with a 178 cm reach; narrow frame with long-looking limbs and a long neck.
body.body_fat_notes: Defined abs and visible veins at weigh-ins; very little fat, modest muscle mass.
body.shoulders: Moderate width, rounded delts, slightly sloped.
body.arms: Lean, sinewy arms with defined forearms.
body.posture: Upright; head carried slightly forward; loose shoulders.
body.notable_physique_traits: Pale, lean, untattooed body; long neck; big protruding ears with a cauliflower left ear; ginger beard against ash-brown hair.

tattoos.description: None visible in the studio cutouts or the 2026 weigh-ins.

accessories_seen: Silver chain with a pendant at the UFC 324 ceremonial weigh-in (Jan 2026); white cap at May 2026 media day.

kit.typical_shorts: Red UFC shorts in both studio cutouts: red with a darker red leaf/chevron pattern and a white-check waistband with a black UFC panel (newer, crypto.com logo); red-and-black Venum-era shorts with white piping (older).
kit.brand_note: Logos visible: UFC, crypto.com (newer), Venum (older). Fight-night kit for 2026 not confirmed from a photo.

stance_and_guard.official_stance: Southpaw (data/derived/fighters.json): right foot and right hand forward. Mirror any orthodox guard clip for him.
stance_and_guard.seen_in_photos: No action photo in the folder; nothing about his guard is inferred.
stance_and_guard.confidence: high for stance, none for guard details

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male (closest swatch) tinted toward #e4ae92, with a pink flush on the cheeks, ears and nose
render_hints.hair: about 6 cm on top with a heavy straight fringe to mid-forehead, sides about 2.5 cm, back tapered; colour #604836. A proxy hair mesh will look closer than a buzz shell.
render_hints.beard: short beard about 6 mm with a fuller moustache, ginger #9a6446

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). l- = the fighter's own left. Big, strongly protruding ears; the left ear swollen (cauliflower), so it gets more depth and less defined folds.

notes: Confidence: high for ears, hair, beard colour, skin and build; medium-high for face proportions (three good fronts, one profile); medium for morphs. One embed-ok photo (2019, CC BY 3.0) and it is out of date. What to watch: (1) big ears that stick straight out, the left one a swollen cauliflower; (2) long narrow face with a long chin; (3) heavy straight fringe of ash-brown hair (2025-26), not the old spiky crop; (4) ginger moustache and short beard, redder than the hair; light ginger brows; (5) blue-grey eyes; (6) fair, pink-flushing skin and a lean, untattooed body with a long neck; (7) southpaw. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js.
